test.create_query: CREATE TABLE jit_date_transforms (t DateTime('UTC'), t_ny DateTime('America/New_York'), d Date, x UInt32) Engine = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO jit_date_transforms SELECT toDateTime('2010-01-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') + cityHash64(number) % 500000000, toDateTime('2010-01-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') + cityHash64(number, 1) % 500000000, toDate('2010-01-01') + cityHash64(number, 2) % 6000, toUInt32(number % 1000) FROM numbers(50000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(toYYYYMM(d) + x) FROM jit_date_transforms SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT sum(toYYYYMMDD(t) + x) FROM jit_date_transforms SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT sum(toMonth(t_ny) * 31 + toDayOfMonth(t_ny)) FROM jit_date_transforms SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT countIf(toYear(t) = 2015 AND toMonth(t) > 6) FROM jit_date_transforms SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT sum(toQuarter(d) + toDaysInMonth(t)) FROM jit_date_transforms SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
